Try itTurn the error into a command: a PID adds three terms

Goal: make the AV's speed \(v\) match the target \(v_{\text{ref}}\) with the throttle and brake.

PID controllerA controller that turns an error into a command with three terms: one in proportion to the error now (P), one to its sum over time (I), and one to how fast it changes (D).
